description: This file defines a report for project profitability in ERPNext, including functions to fetch data, calculate costs and profits, generate chart data, and define report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and charts based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes data for the report.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Retrieves raw data rows from the database based on filters and conditions.

methods.name: calculate_cost_and_profit
methods.description: Calculates fractional cost and profit for each data row.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data (labels and utilization values) from the data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.
